lead.headline: Barkley and Rice both left with hamstring injuries
lead.deck: You trail 57.1 to 59.8 with only Waller left; ESPN gives you 40%. Tate's 21.5 and Gordon's 18.0 were on the bench. Next week: Rice and Waller are on bye.
lead.body: Two starters were gone before either game was a quarter old. Saquon Barkley hurt his right hamstring on his second carry against the Rams and was ruled out; Rashee Rice pulled up with a non-contact left hamstring in Las Vegas and was downgraded to doubtful to return. Neither has a diagnosis. Barkley was walking normally afterwards, by one reporter's account, and Philadelphia's next game is in London. Rice at least has the bye: Kansas City are off in Week 5. The healthy starters didn't cover it. Garrett Wilson caught three passes in a game the Jets threw 15 times, Josh Downs drew four targets with Keenan Allen and Darius Slayton both inactive because the Colts simply ran, and Trevor Lawrence threw 23 times. Jonathan Taylor's 22.7 was the exception. The bench did what the lineup didn't: Carnell Tate had 145 yards on 12 targets for 21.5, Ollie Gordon had 18.0 with Miami still playing, Matthew Golden 11.7 and Bhayshul Tuten 11.1. The flex was a coin flip by projection and no brief chose it; it lost by 16.9. You trail 57.1 to 59.8 with Darren Waller to come tonight, and the only reason it is close is that Team 13 started two players who were ruled out. For Week 5 there is one conditional move, Tuten for Barkley if he is ruled out, and one need: Waller is on bye too, so Tuesday has to find a tight end.
